title: CS daily scratchpad - Liam Peterson - 2026-03-04
content:
2026-03-04 - daily scratchpad (quick hits, todo, QBR prep)

TOP PRIORITIES
- Prep AcmeCorp QBR (3/10) — finalize slides, pull usage/cost metrics, sync with product + SRE.
- Renewal outreach: BrightSide (renewal 4/15) — need updated contract proposal + pricing delta for committed capacity.
- Clear high-priority support tickets (see list) before EOD.

QBR: AcmeCorp (3/10, 10:00 PT)
- Draft agenda: intro (me), adoption highlights (customer success), performance & reliability (SRE/Product), cost breakdown (ops), roadmap ask (product)
- Data to include:
  * MTD tokens (prompt+completion) + 3mo trend (metric owner: analytics)
  * Avg 95p latency per endpoint (prod/region) — get from SRE, ticket SRE-998
  * Error rate / 5xx rate (last 90d) and top error types
  * Cost delta since switching to Redwood Dedicated (estimated $ savings / token)
  * Examples of prompt templates & wins (customer quotes)
- Slides needed: Performance slide (SRE), Cost slide (ops/finance), Roadmap asks (product)
- Action: ping @Maya for analytics export by 3/05; ping @Aisha for SRE blurb + logs by 3/06.

RENEWALS / CONTRACTS
- BrightSide (renewal 2026-04-15) — ARR $120k; current usage trending +10% q/q. Risk: wants better auto-scaling guarantees for end-of-month spikes.
  * TODO: Draft 1-pager on autoscale policy + burst buffer proposal (due 3/08).
  * Owner: Liam; Collab: Solutions Eng (ask Rajiv for technical note).
- NeoHealth (renewal 2026-05-02) — privacy/compliance questions unresolved (private deployment eval).
  * TODO: schedule tech deep-dive with Private Deployments team (target week of 3/22).
- TinyShop (renewal in 60 days) — up-sell opportunity: Optimize trial for caching recommendations.

SUPPORT FOLLOW-UPS (high priority)
- CS-4521: intermittent KV cache corruption on 3/02 — escalated to infra, assigned to Priya (status: in progress). Need ETA for fix and mitigation steps for customer.
- CS-4599: tokenization mismatch for Spanish locale (TinyShop) — workaround (force model v2.1) provided; follow up if any regressions.
- CS-4610: Dedicated pool latency spike 2/28 region eu-west — SRE investigating (linked: SRE-998).

DAILY TASKS / TODOs
- [ ] Export AcmeCorp usage report (analytics) — pinged Maya (waiting).
- [ ] Draft BrightSide autoscale one-pager (3/08).
- [ ] Email renewal notice + proposed window to BrightSide legal (Liam).
- [ ] Follow up on CS-4521 for mitigation notes to customer (ETA?).
- [ ] Add QBR action items to Confluence page and share with account exec.

OUTREACH / TEMPLATE NOTES
- Renewal outreach template: short subject, reminder of value (latency/cost wins), propose 3 time slots for 30-min call. Include link to renewal doc + MSA.
- QBR template: 6 slides max: 1) summary & ask 2) adoption metrics 3) performance 4) incidents/ops 5) roadmap & requests 6) next steps + owners.

MEETINGS TODAY
- 09:00 PT — team standup (15m)
- 11:00 PT — AcmeCorp pre-brief w/ Maya + Aisha (30m)
- 14:00 PT — BrightSide check-in (15m)
- 16:00 PT — office hours (drop in)

OPEN QUESTIONS / NOTES TO SELF
- Do we have a standardized autoscale/burst SLA we can offer for mid-market? If not, create draft policy.
- Confirm whether cost slide should show raw $ or $/1M tokens normalized — likely both but keep it simple.
- Customer requests for private deployment timeline: check with Private Deploys on onboarding lead time (typical: 6-8 weeks).

QUICK LINKS
- Confluence QBR template: confluence:CS-QBR-template-2026
- SRE ticket: SRE-998
- Renewal tracker sheet: https://sheets.redwood.internal/renewals-2026

NOTES / SCRIBBLES
- BrightSide likes deterministic scale during EOM bursts — maybe offer guaranteed burst credits for 3 months as trial.
- For Acme QBR: pull one or two customer success stories (short quotes) — highlight 30% faster response time after migrating to Redwood.
- If SRE can't commit to full fix before QBR, prepare mitigation slide + plan of action.

END OF DAY CHECK
- Send follow up summary for Acme pre-brief to attendees (Liam)
- Mark items blocked in tracker and escalate renewals if legal delays > 5 business days.

(Notes are rough — will tidy before sharing externally)
